Note:
- Signed with the production Kuro Anime release certificate so it installs cleanly
  as an in-place upgrade over v1.5.3 / earlier 1.5.4-beta without wiping history.
- GitHub Releases and main branch remain on v1.5.3 (official public release).

What's Included & Fixed in 1.5.4-beta:
1. 40 Anime & Manga Profile Art Sets (PFPs + Matching 16:9 Banners):
   - Expanded Profile Art from 24 to 40 character pairs (art-11 .. art-50),
     keeping all 24 existing sets and adding 16 iconic anime character PFPs +
     matching 16:9 banners: Monkey D. Luffy (Gear 5), Roronoa Zoro, Itachi
     Uchiha, Naruto Uzumaki, Sasuke Uchiha, Tanjiro Kamado, Kyojuro Rengoku,
     Killua Zoldyck, Ken Kaneki, Thorfinn, Guts, Lelouch Lamperouge, Power,
     Okarun (Turbo Granny), Zero Two, and Spike Spiegel.

2. Fixed Theme Colours Picker (All 20 Accents):
   - Fixed a strict-mode ReferenceError (`host is not defined`) inside
     `theme-accent-1.1.js` `schedule()` that prevented the 20-colour Theme Accent
     picker (`#accent-111`) from mounting inside Settings -> Appearance.

3. Fixed MyAnimeList & AniList Two-Way Sync:
   - Fixed episode watch detection across embedded iframe players (`megaplay`,
     `vidtube`, `vidnest`, `tryembed`, `hianimes`, `zorotv`), direct HLS stream
     playback, and native ExoPlayer so episodes mark watched & sync at >= 85%
     playback.
   - Fixed `TrackerSync553` progress advancement on mid-season / non-sequential
     episodes, added automatic AniList + MyAnimeList ID resolution
     (`autoResolveIds154`), routed `AccountHttp` through `KuroFastNet154`
     (Encrypted DoH `1.1.1.1` / `8.8.8.8`), and enabled true two-way refresh on
     `Sync Now`.

4. Fixed Discord Login & Rich Presence Account Linking:
   - Added Android 15 (`targetSdkVersion 35`) `https` `BROWSABLE` `<queries>`
     visibility and explicit web-browser package selection (`openInBrowser154`)
     so the Discord Android app (`com.discord`) no longer hijacks OAuth URLs, and
     wired Account Hub's "Connect Discord" button directly to native Discord
     Social SDK PKCE OAuth (`linkDirect154`).

5. Buttery-Smooth Native Scrolling, Compact SUB | DUB Pills, Signature Violet
   Default, Smart DoH + Decoder Fallback, Multi-Layer Ad Guard, Android 15
   Edge-to-Edge Insets, and Unified Account Hub.
